'''Shusk''' was a [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] rancher who watched over a herd of [[bildog]]s and [[proop]]s. Shusk and [[Kimsh]] became friends with the [[Shi'ido]] [[Mammon Hoole]], who was disguised as a fellow Chadra-Fan in order to observe the [[Species/Legends|species]] in their natural environment. During an ocean voyage, a storm struck, forcing Hoole to reveal his true identity when he used his [[Changeling/Legends|shapeshifting]] abilities to save his new friends. When Hoole apologized for the deception, Shusk told him that he could have just asked them what he wanted to know since they were willing to talk to anyone.<ref name="EGTAS" />
